verdict.rationale: Featurebase's own site states that you can 'segment your product releases by user attributes to always send out targeted release notes', which matches the story directly. Its changelog delivery channels support this: embeddable in-app widgets and email subscriptions. However, the evidence is a single marketing-level claim with no detailed documentation. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on which user attributes can be used and how segments are configured, how segmentation applies across the email and widget channels, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
